mapper.sql: SELECT j.job_id, j.kind, j.username, j.retry_of, j.created_at, j.confirmed_at, j.scope::text AS scope, i.total, i.ready, i.queued, i.running, i.succeeded, i.skipped, i.failed, i.has_retryable_failure, CASE WHEN i.running > 0 OR (i.queued > 0 AND i.succeeded + i.failed + i.skipped > 0 AND i.ready = 0 AND (j.kind != 'ORIGINAL_IMPORT' OR j.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN i.queued > 0 THEN 'QUEUED' WHEN i.ready > 0 THEN 'READY' WHEN i.failed > 0 AND i.succeeded > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN i.failed > 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'SUCCEEDED' END AS state, CASE WHEN i.queued + i.running + i.ready = 0 THEN i.finished_at END AS finished_at FROM v2_job j CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::int AS total, max(x.finished_at) AS finished_at, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.state = 'READY'))::int AS ready, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.state = 'QUEUED'))::int AS queued, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.state = 'RUNNING'))::int AS running, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.state = 'SUCCEEDED'))::int AS succeeded, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.state = 'SKIPPED'))::int AS skipped, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.state = 'FAILED'))::int AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.state = 'FAILED' AND ) > 0 AS has_retryable_failure FROM v2_job_item x WHERE x.job_id = j.job_id ) i
WHERE job_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND state = #{state}
job_id, kind, sequence, target, paper_id, file_revision, record_version, input::text AS input, state, message, result::text AS result
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO v2_job (job_id, kind, username, scope, retry_of) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{kind}, #{username}, CAST(#{scope} AS jsonb), CAST(#{retryOf} AS uuid))

mapper.select: WITH chosen AS ( SELECT i.job_id, i.sequence FROM v2_job_item i JOIN v2_job j USING (job_id) WHERE i.state = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY j.created_at, i.sequence, i.job_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF i SKIP LOCKED ), claimed AS ( UPDATE v2_job_item i SET state = 'RUNNING', claim_until = now() + #{seconds} * interval '1 second' FROM chosen c WHERE i.job_id = c.job_id AND i.sequence = c.sequence RETURNING i.* ) SELECT FROM claimed
mapper.update: UPDATE v2_job_item SET state = 'FAILED', claim_until = NULL, finished_at = now(), message = '任务执行中断，可重试' WHERE state = 'RUNNING' AND claim_until < now()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM v2_job_item WHERE job_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND sequence = #{sequence} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND claim_until > now())
mapper.update: UPDATE v2_job_item SET state = #{state}, claim_until = NULL, finished_at = now(), message = #{message}, result = COALESCE(CAST(#{result} AS jsonb), CASE WHEN kind = 'PARSE' THEN result END) WHERE job_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND sequence = #{sequence} AND state = 'RUNNING'
